from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """Metadata extracted from a single judgment document."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document as written")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The legal cause of action (案由) stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
